title: fix(app-shell): flow designer names nodes by label, not id (objectui#13143)
body:
Fixes #13143
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The flow designer named a node by its id in three places. It now names it by the name its author gave it, through one rule, `flowNodeDisplayName` (beside `defaultNodeLabel` in `previews/flow-canvas-parts.tsx`): the author's `label` when it is a non-blank string, else the palette label of the node's type, else the id.

- **Problems messages of a decision** (`validateFlowDraft`). `decisionNoDefault`, `decisionMultipleDefaults` and `decisionNoBranches` now read `Decision "Check budget" (node_1) has no default branch; ...`. The id stays beside the name, so two decisions that share a label can still be told apart. The copy changed in the designer i18n table, en and zh (zh follows the table's `“{fieldLabel}”（{field}）` form).
- **A connection's title.** `FlowEdgeInspector`'s header and Studio's host header (`flowSelectionHeading`) read `Check budget → Notify team`, through `flowEdgeDisplayName`. The title is now read off the edge itself, not off the selection's `label`: every producer of an edge selection writes that label once, from ids, and it goes stale when an end node is renamed. The selection label is still used when the edge is missing. The reconnect re-selection writes the same name-based label.
- **A run's steps** (`FlowRunsPanel`'s `StepRow`). `FlowPreview` passes the flow's `nodes`. Each step shows its node's name beside the type, with the id in the `title` attribute. Nodes inside regions are named too: the walk is the spec's `collectFlowGraphs`. A step whose node the flow no longer has, or a panel rendered without `nodes`, shows the id as before.

Nothing is added to the package entry: no export, prop or language-pack key. One changeset: `.changeset/13143-flow-node-labels.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Pins

New file `previews/flowNodeLabels-13143.test.tsx`:

- (a) Problems: a Decision labelled "Check budget" with no default branch reads `"Check budget" (node_1)`, and so do the other two decision messages.
- (b) Edge inspector title and host header: `Check budget → Notify team`.
- (c) Run step: `Check budget` is shown beside `decision`, `title` is `node_1`. A step for a deleted node shows its id.
- (d) Control: an unlabelled decision reads `Decision`, a blank label also falls back, an unlabelled node of a non-palette type reads its id, and an edge end that names no node reads its id.

Two existing pins asserted the old id titles. They now assert the names: the reconnect labels in `FlowEdgeInspector.endpoints-11905.test.tsx` (`Tell the owner → Review`, `Review → End`) and the Studio connection header in `AutomationsPillar.nodeAside-12488.test.tsx` (`Hot lead? → Hot`).

**Ablation.** `flowNodeDisplayName` was pointed back at the id (anchor `if (typeof node.label === 'string' && node.label.trim()) return node.label;` replaced with `return node.id;`) through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `9d465286d507` to `79dd103198eb`. The pin file went `6 failed (6)`: (a), (b) and (c) failed, and so did (d), as expected, because its palette fallback sits behind the same line. Restore was proven by blob hash: after restore the blob was `9d465286d507`, the HEAD blob was `9d465286d507`, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. The tests import source directly, with no `dist/` hop, so no rebuild was needed.

## Verification (head `35daa8756d`, base `9840695f67`)

- Closure build `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, 0 `error TS`. The first run caught a missing `readOnly` prop in the new test, which was fixed in `a3171b2690`.
- Targeted vitest (`--maxWorkers=1`, under the shared lock): every test file that names a touched module (56 files): 1 failed and 55 passed. The one failure was the Studio header pin above, which asserted the old id title. It was updated and re-run, and passes: 4 of 4. The new pin plus the endpoints pin: 14 of 14.
- The whole `packages/app-shell/` directory was not run locally, per the lock rules for this dispatch. CI runs it.
- Lint, narrowed to the 9 changed app-shell files. The checked set comes from the root `eslint.config.js`, the config the package's `lint` script (`eslint .`) uses. The count, 9 files, is read from `--format json`. The result was 0 errors and 21 warnings: 2 new `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings for the two helpers added to `flow-canvas-parts.tsx`, and the rest were already there. The narrowing cannot hide a finding in another file: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it did not touch.
- Pre-tsc gates, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (3 designer en values changed, 3 zh followed), `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` and `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1 with `no-artifact` (no full workspace build). That is the known state on main and is recorded only.

## Acceptance notes

- **The edge title carries no id in a tooltip.** The ruling asks for the id in a `title` on the edge title. `InspectorShell` (`inspectors/_shared.tsx`) sets its header's `title` attribute to the title text, and that file is outside this claim's file surface, so the id is not one hover away on the header. The From / To pickers directly under the header already read `label · id`. If the hover is wanted, the change is a `titleHint` prop on `InspectorShell`. The run step does carry the id in `title`.
- **Other places in the same family still name nodes by id. None was changed here:** `ProblemsPanel`'s target column (`targetLabel`, `p.target.nodeId` and `source → target`), and `nodeUnreachable`, `duplicateNodeId`, `boundaryHostMissing`, `edgeSourceMissing` and `edgeTargetMissing` in `flow-sim-validate.ts`. The last four name ids by design, because they point at a missing or duplicated id. Selection labels written by `FlowPreview` (problem click and canvas edge select) and by `FlowObjectListField`'s "Edit connection" are still id-based. No title reads them any more for an edge that exists.
- objectui#13135 edits `FlowPreview.tsx`'s `FlowMetaPills` header, a different region from this change. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
